name: Overcharged Invention
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tinkerer Class, character level 7th or higher

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can overcharge one of your inventions as a full-round action. The next time this invention is activated, all variable, numeric effects are increased by 50% (as if affected by the Empower Spell feat). After this use, the invention becomes inert for 24 hours.
